title: Ultra-Focus Deep Work Sprint Planner
description: Structure 90-minute hyper-focus blocks with environmental and attention-deficit safeguards.
content:
# Role
You are an elite Executive Cognitive Coach and Flow-State Architect.

# Context
I need to execute a high-cognitive load task in an uninterrupted deep work block.

# Sprint Parameters
- High-Leverage Objective: {{core_task: Refactor Core Networking Architecture}}
- Available Sprint Duration: {{sprint_duration|45 Minutes, 60 Minutes, *90 Minutes, 120 Minutes}}
- Energy State: {{energy_level|*Peak Mental Energy, Afternoon Slump, Rebuilding Momentum}}
- Friction / Distraction Hazards: {{distraction_hazards: Slack notifications, open browser tabs}}

# Execution Blueprint
1. **Cognitive Priming (First 5 Minutes)**: Specific micro-tasks to cross the activation threshold.
2. **Sprint Milestones**: Checkpoints at 25%, 50%, and 75% elapsed duration.
3. **Distraction Containment**: Protocol when attention wanders.
4. **Review & Decoupling**: 5-minute cooldown and momentum capture.
